summary.plain: The international team of physicists who built and ran the Belle detector at the KEK laboratory in Japan and analysed its data.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the Belle detector at KEKB from 1999 to 2010; roughly 60 institutions in 14 countries during operation, still publishing analyses of the recorded data set.
